digest.component_or_area: completion verifier step budget and cross-run PASS-verdict caching
propositions: Completion verifier step budgets exhaust on legitimate validation due to undersized defaults and missing evidence-surface scaling, causing false criterion failures that incentivize attestation-laundering
Existing runaway guards (tool_calls_limit, loop detection, clamp) render the small budget redundant for safety while introducing artificial validation failures
Re-verification of unchanged criteria wastes wall-clock time (~10 min/cycle) because step-sizing is criteria-count-only and lacks cross-run verdict caching
Epic-class criteria traverse multiple child tickets at 5-10 requests each but budget sizing ignores child count, creating systematic undersizing for multi-child hierarchies
A scoped, content-aware pass-verdict cache keyed by criterion text + file-impact blob fingerprints enables reuse across runs while invalidating on file edits or reference changes
Seeded cached verdicts must be excluded from the primary agent's work surface and protected from finalizer downgrade to prevent re-verification spam and ensure cache coherence
